_status: FINAL (Jeff, 2026-10-15). Keys that start with an underscore are notes, not text. {name} in a value is replaced by the Echo's display name. A missing key shows nothing. Rule: no number and no id in any text.

stop.arrived_at: They have arrived at a destination.
stop.capacity_spent: They can take no more steps.
stop.paused_to_read: They see something worth pausing for.
stop.no_route: There is no way on from here.

cause.terrain: The path knows only one direction.
cause.situation: They recall this. This problem is known.

purpose.reposition: This is a better place to move from.

route.direct: No hesitation. They go straight at it.
route.skirted: It is not worth it. Better to avoid the known danger.

echo_reason.steadied: The group has given {name} some motivation back.
